caveats: Hot-day runs were searched only within the target period, as specified, so a physical event beginning in late May 2013 would be reported with onset 2013-06-01 (context: 356 of 3301 sea cells were at or above threshold on 2013-05-31 and 361 on 2013-05-30, though no cell had >=5 consecutive hot days ending 2013-05-31). Baseline pools include the window-extension days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 required by the method; all pools were complete (121 values, 63 for 29 Feb) and all 3301 region sea cells had finite SST on every target day, so missing data did not affect the result.
